input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.
input.rationale: Compliant at the preferred position; no redline proposed. Duration: 19.2 gives ninety days (90 days, i.e. three months) for Deliverable conformity, measured from the later of delivery or acceptance, and hosted Services must conform throughout the subscription term (a continuous, full-term software warranty that exceeds the preferred 12 months). The warranty period therefore satisfies the >=90-day threshold; the automated period check failed only because the document writes the number out as "ninety days" rather than "90" or "ninety (90)" - a phrasing artifact, not a substantive shortfall, and not worth a redline. Standard of performance: 19.1 warrants Services performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel per industry standards, plus material conformity of Services and Deliverables to documentation and agreed specifications. Remedy: 19.4 tracks the model language - prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, and if Vendor cannot cure within a reasonable period, termination of the affected item plus refund of Fees paid for it - and is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. 19.3 adds the malicious-code and Applicable Law compliance warranties. Disclaimer: there is no "AS IS" language anywhere in the Agreement; 19.5 disclaims implied warranties only and expressly provides that no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity, confidentiality or data-protection duty, or stated remedy, so the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranties and walk-away territory is not implicated. Section 6.2 adds a further refund right after two failed correction cycles.
